run_curate_ddad: run the DDAD dataset curation script to extract camera images and depth data from the validation split
extract_depth_points: extract 100 random non-zero depth points per camera image from the DDAD dataset using lidar-generated depth
save_camera_images: save RGB camera images from the DDAD validation split to a specified output directory
export_intrinsics: export camera intrinsics including focal length, principal point, and image dimensions to a JSONL file
load_ddad_dataset: load the DDAD train-val dataset using DGP SynchronizedSceneDataset with lidar and camera datums
